architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.subtitle: Backend, frontend and user workflow at a glance.
architecture.backendBody: Python 3.11+ · FastAPI under /api/v1/ · Pydantic v2 · SQLAlchemy 2 + SQLite + Alembic · 5 parsers .pdf (PyMuPDF), .docx (python-docx), .pptx (python-pptx), .xlsx (openpyxl), .txt/.md. .pptx export via template filling (placeholders {{key}}, XXX markers, LLM zones). RAG indexing: chunking + Mistral embeddings + cosine search (numpy float32 as SQLite BLOB). SSE streaming via sse-starlette and httpx.AsyncClient. structlog JSON + X-Request-Id propagated.
architecture.frontendBody: React 18 + strict TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind (shared preset) + React Hook Form + Zod + i18next + Zustand + TanStack Query. Components via @internal/ui and tokens via @internal/design-tokens. SSE consumed with fetch + ReadableStream. A standalone HTML fallback (vanilla JS, no Node) is embedded in the backend for build-free use.
steps: Settings tab → enter the Mistral key and test the connection. The key is stored locally in SQLite (app_config table).
Documents tab → drag & drop PDF / DOCX / PPTX / XLSX / TXT / MD. Parsing, SHA-256 dedup, chunking then Mistral embeddings — all synchronous (POC).
Generate tab → select scope documents (empty = all), pick a template, write an editorial brief, run.
The backend creates a Session, searches similar chunks (cosine k=12), assembles the prompt with the writer system prompt and streams the response via SSE (events session → token* → done).
The generated content is persisted as a Message (assistant role) with its [filename] citations. You can review every session in the Sessions tab.
To share: package.bat produces a standalone ZIP (Python embed + frontend dist + design-tokens). The recipient double-clicks start.bat and it is ready.
